content.user_title: Create Short Links and Check Appie Click Analytics
content.value_statement: Long URLs are difficult to share, and link performance can be unclear. This skill uses Appie MCP tools to create short links and retrieve click statistics.
actual_capabilities: Create short links for HTTP or HTTPS destinations through the Appie create_short_link tool.
Validate optional custom codes containing 4 to 32 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
Add an HTTPS scheme when a destination URL lacks one and request corrections for invalid URLs.
Retrieve total clicks and a 30-day click series using a link id or short code.
Report the returned short URL, numeric id, code, and one-credit creation cost.
Create multiple requested links sequentially and report individual results.
limitations: Requires an Appie.run MCP connection and a valid project API key configured outside chat.
Each link creation costs one credit; insufficient credits stop creation without retries.
Only creation and statistics tools are documented; editing, deletion, and custom domains are not covered.
Statistics depend on API results and cover total clicks plus a 30-day series, not documented demographic analytics.

use_cases.title: Prepare Campaign Links
use_cases.description: Create memorable short codes for campaign destinations and retain link identifiers for later click checks.

use_cases.title: Share Publication Links
use_cases.description: Shorten article or newsletter URLs and report the creation cost alongside each returned link.

use_cases.title: Review Link Engagement
use_cases.description: Retrieve total clicks and a 30-day click series for an existing project link.

prompt_templates.title: Shorten One URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Shorten [destination URL] with Appie and show the returned link, id, code, and credit cost.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Custom Code
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Appie short link for [destination URL] using [custom code]. Validate the code before creating the link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: choose a recognizable link code.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Click History
prompt_templates.prompt: Get Appie statistics for code [short code]. Show total clicks and the 30-day click series in a compact table.

prompt_templates.title: Create Several Campaign Links
prompt_templates.prompt: Create Appie links for [URL and custom code pairs] sequentially. Report each result and credit cost, and stop if credits run out.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: process several destinations with individual results.

output_examples.input: Create a short link with the custom code abc.
output_examples.output: The code abc is too short. Use 4 to 32 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens. No link was created.

output_examples.input: Shorten my URL when the Appie MCP tools are unavailable.
output_examples.output: Connect the Appie MCP server at https://appie.run/mcp and configure your project API key in your client. Do not paste the key into chat.

output_examples.input: Show click statistics without a link id or code.
output_examples.output: Please provide the numeric link id or short code so I can retrieve its click statistics.

best_practices: Configure your project API key in the MCP client, never in chat.
Check destination URLs and custom codes before spending credits on creation.
Keep returned link ids and codes, and rely only on API results for URLs and statistics.
anti_patterns: Submitting private URLs or URLs containing secrets without considering their disclosure to Appie.
Retrying link creation after an insufficient-credit error.
Treating suggested codes, example links, or estimated click counts as verified API results.

faq.question: What must I connect before using this skill?
faq.answer: Connect the Appie.run MCP server and configure a valid project API key in your client. Never paste the key into chat.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Each short link creation costs one credit. Statistics requests are free according to the skill documentation.

faq.question: Can I choose my own short code?
faq.answer: Yes. Codes must contain 4 to 32 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens. Unavailable codes require another choice.

faq.question: Which statistics can I retrieve?
faq.answer: The documented statistics tool returns total clicks and a 30-day series of dates and click counts.

faq.question: Can it create multiple links?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates requested links one by one and reports each result. It stops if credits are insufficient.

faq.question: Can I edit or delete existing links?
faq.answer: No editing or deletion tool is documented. The skill covers creating short links and retrieving statistics.
